name: kmacmcfarlane
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Kyle McFarlane — dev tooling and reusable skills.

plugins.name: kit-dev
plugins.description: Maintainer tooling for this plugin ecosystem — skill creation, project scaffolding, upstream kit sync, and factoring analysis (external: the claude-templates repo, which scaffolding reads, and the claude-templates, claude-sandbox and claude-expertise repos, which upstream sync writes).

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Context survival for long sessions — depth gate, checkpoint workflow, session rehydration, and token-spend reporting from the local transcripts (soft dependency: statusline, for exact depth).

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Always-on status line — context left, plan usage limits, model and session name at a glance (optional: works with context-guard, which adds its epoch and checkpoint thresholds to the gauge).

plugins.name: statusline-hub
plugins.description: The status-line slot, shared — a tee command that records the context depth and plan usage Claude Code hands the status line into the sensor record other tools read, whatever renders your line (a ccstatusline Custom Command, a Starship custom module, or a wrapper around your own command). First piece of the shared-slot dispatcher.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge, multi-agent research fan-outs, chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items; statusline, for rate-limit reset times).

plugins.name: work-items
plugins.description: Repo-durable work items for humans and agents — the wi CLI over one-markdown-file-per-item stores, and the work-source provider interface.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Conversational skills — structured product research and purchase recommendations.

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Isolated execution for Claude Code sessions — configure, bootstrap and troubleshoot claude-sandbox containers, with the checkout/worktree convention their launcher follows enforced by a PreToolUse guard.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Unattended agent loops over a backlog — the backlog.yaml workflow for ralph runs. Requires the claude-sandbox tool (see the sandbox plugin); consumes a work source through the work-source interface, with backlog.yaml as the default provider (soft dependency: work-items, whose work-source provider interface it implements).
